description: This header file provides utility functions and templates for managing smart pointers, including creation, conversion, and traits, as part of the Abseil C++ library's memory utilities.

classes.name: ExtractOr
classes.description: A template struct that evaluates to a specific type based on whether a template instantiation is valid, used internally for traits extraction.

classes.name: allocator_is_nothrow
classes.description: A traits class that determines if an allocator's allocation function is noexcept.

methods.name: WrapUnique
methods.description: Wraps a raw pointer into a std::unique_ptr, with static assertions to prevent arrays and non-object types.

methods.name: make_unique
methods.description: Alias for std::make_unique, used to create std::unique_ptr instances safely.

methods.name: RawPtr
methods.description: Extracts a raw pointer from a pointer-like object or returns nullptr if input is nullptr.

methods.name: ShareUniquePtr
methods.description: Converts a std::unique_ptr into a std::shared_ptr, transferring ownership.

methods.name: WeakenPtr
methods.description: Creates a std::weak_ptr from a std::shared_ptr.
